candidates.hook: THE PRIEST: "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you... husband and wife!"
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Ashcroft points venomously at Juliana screaming, "You are disowned!"
candidates.why: Combines the rapid wedding pronouncement with the dramatic climax of her family publicly disowning her, creating maximum intrigue for her next move.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was dumped at the altar by her fiancé Gerald for her sister.

candidates.hook: JULIANA: "If this is pity, take back your ring. I will not become anyone's charity."
candidates.cliffhanger: The priest raises his hands over the couple, saying "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..." cutting right before the pronouncement finishes.
candidates.why: Delivers an intense romantic vow and pride-driven negotiation cut right at the split-second before they are officially wed.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was publicly betrayed and humiliated by her fiancé and family moments earlier.

candidates.hook: GERALD: "Look at him. A penniless nobody for a discarded bride."
candidates.cliffhanger: The scarred warrior softly tells Juliana, "I know they have made you stand alone," right before she decides whether to accept his ring.
candidates.why: Establishes clear villain cruelty versus a mysterious protector standing up for an abandoned bride.
candidates.context_needed: Gerald abandoned Juliana at the altar to marry her sister Clarissa.

moments.desc: Gerald and Clarissa taunt Juliana and her mystery suitor, calling them worthless.
Juliana refuses pity, prompting the scarred warrior to declare his proposal is a solemn vow.
The mysterious warrior delivers his vows and the priest pronounces them husband and wife.
Lady Ashcroft screams at Juliana and disowns her in front of the chapel.
